login.description: Login used to perform the restore on the device

password.description: Password of the login user; optional, a fresh install has none

use_ssl.description: Use https to talk to the OpenWRT device

apply_sysupgrade.description: Apply the sysupgrade once the backup archive has been uploaded

reboot_device.description: Reboot the device after the sysupgrade; inhibited when apply_sysupgrade is false

timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for the device to respond

insecure_skip_verify.description: Disable TLS certificate verification (dangerous; OpenWRT ships a self-signed certificate)
